attributes.name: [Chargeback] Deployment with chargeback group missing usage data

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| WHERE deployment_group != ""
| EVAL billing_deployment_id = deployment_id
| DROP deployment_id
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution ON composite_key
| WHERE cluster_name IS NULL
| INLINE STATS count = COUNT(*) BY billing_deployment_id, deployment_name, deployment_group
| EVAL result = CONCAT("Deployment `", COALESCE(deployment_name, billing_deployment_id, "unknown"), "` (`", COALESCE(billing_deployment_id, "unknown"), "`) in deployment group `", deployment_group, "` did not have usage data since ", LEFT(composite_key, 10), ".")
| STATS result = VALUES(result)
| MV_EXPAND result
